newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast East European sales rise in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast East European sales rise in Q1.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker group Graboplast Rt said on Wednesday that in the first quarter of 1997 it had maintained a high level of exports with a rising proportion going to east Europe.
"The proportion of exports (within total sales) remained high (60 percent) and the rise in east European exports continued," Graboplast said in its earnings report.
"The Russian, Polish, Czech and Slovak markets were the most important ones in the first quarter," it said.

Graboplast released its first quarter consolidated earnings report on Wednesday, showing a rise in after-tax profits to 475.5 million forints from 215.5 million in the same period of 1996. Sales rose to 4.019 billion from 3.142 billion.

In volume terms, the company reported a 23 percent rise wallpaper sales, a 42 percent increase in floor cover sales and a 10 percent rise in carpet sales. The rise in volumes occurred mostly on the east European markets.
